about: Общие эталоны модели вариограммы (ТЗ 8.6.3; ADR 0022 §6; ТД14-3): ядро — bf_core/geostat/variogram/model.py (tests/test_vario_model.py), окно — ui/src/modules/variography/model.ts
rules:
model = {c0, structures: [{type, c, ang1, ang2, ang3, a1, a2, a3}], common_axes} (ADR 0022, 12): c0 - the nugget, c - the contribution, a1..a3 - the ranges along the axes of the structure, angles of GSLIB in degrees. With common_axes the angles of every structure are those of the first.
Axes of a structure: the rows u1, u2, u3 of R(ang1, ang2, ang3) - frames.json `rules` (sin/cos of degrees exact at the multiples of 90).
Reduced distance of the lag vector d = (x, y, z) in a structure: q_i = (x*u_i.x + y*u_i.y + z*u_i.z) / a_i (the sum left to right), hr = sqrt(q1*q1 + q2*q2 + q3*q3).
Shapes g(hr): spherical - hr*(1.5 - 0.5*hr*hr) when hr < 1, else 1; exponential - 1 - exp(-3*hr), computed as -expm1(-3*hr); gaussian - -expm1(-3*hr*hr). The ranges are practical: g(1) = 1 - exp(-3) for the last two.
gamma(d) = 0 when d = (0, 0, 0); otherwise c0 + c_1*g_1(hr_1) + c_2*g_2(hr_2) + ... (left to right). sill = c0 + c_1 + c_2 + ... (left to right); cov(d) = sill - gamma(d).
curves: gamma at d = (h*u.x, h*u.y, h*u.z) for every h; `axis` 1..3 - u is the axis of the first structure (of zero angles when there is none), null - the direction (cos p*sin Az, cos p*cos Az, -sin p) of `azimuth` Az and `plunge` p (positive down). The second h is 1e-6: the nugget jump. points: single lag vectors `delta` with hr of every structure, gamma and cov.
form2d (the model of the tab «Статистика», as BF): {nug, structures: [{it, cc, hmaj, hmin, azi}]} is the model with c0 = nug and type = it (1 - spherical, 2 - exponential, 3 - gaussian), c = cc, ang1 = azi (reduced to [0, 360)), ang2 = ang3 = 0, a1 = hmaj, a2 = a3 = hmin; common_axes - whether all azi are equal.
Tolerances: gamma and cov - 1e-12*max(1, sill); hr - 1e-12 relative.
